en: Vintage green-tinted postcard view of an elegant late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villa with ornate façades in a tree‑lined area, with a spired building in the background. The caption on the front reads "Brașov" and "Livada poștei." The reverse is a Romanian divided back printed "România — Cartă Postală," with a long handwritten Romanian message, Brașov postal cancellations, and an address to a painter/professor. Publisher imprint from a Brașov bookshop on Strada Hirscher is visible.
